title: Introducing the Barnacle: parking enforcement tool.
description: Introducing the Barnacle – a new way to enforce parking violations in San Marcos. This device attaches to a vehicle’s windshield if it has three or more unpaid parking tickets. Tampering with it triggers an alarm and alerts parking enforcement, but paying off fines is quick and easy. Just scan the QR code, pay online, enter your release code, and return the Barnacle. Watch to see it in action!
